claims.assertion: Mari claimed at least 400,000 human-like civilizations exist in her galactic sector, including populations genetically similar to terrestrial humans.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She said non-Earth human civilizations commonly trace human origins to planets around Vega in Lyra and associate their migration with the Great Expansion and Orion Wars.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She added humans existed earlier and elsewhere too.

claims.assertion: Mari said Taygeta attributes most human genetic alteration to mental and perceptual control, which she claimed can be reversed through individual consciousness expansion.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
